parameters.name: Accessibility
parameters.description:
The visibility of the image. Currently only takes effect for custom images.

- PUBLIC: Public.
- PRIVATE: Private.

parameters.name: Labels
parameters.description:
The label filter conditions. Separate multiple conditions with commas (,).
The format of a single filter condition is `Key=Value`.
Valid values of Key:

- system.chipType
- system.dsw.cudaVersion
- system.dsw.fromImageId
- system.dsw.fromInstanceId
- system.dsw.id
- system.dsw.os
- system.dsw.osVersion
- system.dsw.resourceType
- system.dsw.rootImageId
- system.dsw.stage
- system.dsw.tag
- system.dsw.type
- system.framework
- system.origin
- system.pythonVersion
- system.source
- system.supported.dlc
- system.supported.dsw

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The image name. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: Options
parameters.description: The options. Currently supports ExactMatchName for exact match search on Name.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order for the specified sort field in a paged query. Used together with SortBy. Default value: ASC.
- ASC: Ascending order.
- DESC: Descending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the image list. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: Fuzzy searches by image name and description.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: The sort field for a paged query. Currently, the GmtCreateTime field is used for sorting.

parameters.name: Verbose
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to display non-essential information. Non-essential information currently includes Labels. Valid values:

- true: Includes non-essential information.
- false: Does not include non-essential information.

parameters.name: WorkspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace ID. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~).
